_about: Summaries with the right verdict per check, in order claim, qualifier, examples, added: y met, n not met, ? not scored (reasonable teachers could differ). Used by eval_test.go (go test -tags eval ./internal/ai, needs GROQ_API_KEYS and a site build for dist/ai/rc.json). Add a case whenever a student reports a wrong verdict.
